title: CI runs pytest, ruff and mypy for the analysis package
description:
No CI job touches `analysis/`. `analysis/pyproject.toml` declares only `pytest` as a dev dependency and has no `[tool.ruff]`, `[tool.mypy]` or pytest configuration.

Done when: a CI job creates the venv, installs `analysis[dev]`, runs `pytest analysis/tests`, `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` and `mypy analysis/apricity_analyze`; the configuration for all three lives in `pyproject.toml`. The heavy ML dependencies may be skipped in CI by a dependency extra (see the packaging issue) as long as the server, curation, markup and theory tests run.
